name: normalize and save transcript text to a file
definition: Clean the transcript so punctuation/case do not hide the content and write it to the required output path.
failure_mode: File missing or content differs in spokens letters.

name: normalize filesystem permission bits, timestamps, and ownership metadata
definition: normalize filesystem permission bits, timestamps, and ownership metadata
failure_mode: Real filesystem modes/times bleed into members and cause inconsistency.

name: partition a per-key sorted series into successive rounds
definition: For each question key, assign its earliest record to round one, the middle to round two, and the latest to round three, then reassemble round-wise files.
failure_mode: Wrong partition rule produces mismatching per-run files.

name: persist the exact final message to a results file
definition: write the discovered final message (after any required extraction) as the exact expected text into the results file in /app.
failure_mode: any spacing/typo in the captured message fails equality
